_readme: Every event on the site renders from this file. Edit or add events here with no code changes. Event titles and categories were carried over from the Kellogg Live Events page (sample content). Dates, times, locations, costs, hosts, summaries and registration links are NOT confirmed, so every entry is a PLACEHOLDER. Set placeholder to false only when every field is confirmed. ceCredit stays false unless CE credit is confirmed in writing. Types: weekly-online, live-training, business-summit. summary should state a practical takeaway in one sentence (for example: Leave with a checklist for [topic]), never an earnings or results promise. replay: true, false, or null (unconfirmed).
